purpose: checks of the frozen embedding interfaces, run on a pilot contact sheet (pilot realization 100, Gray-Scott, zero Dirichlet) and test-bank text decks before any test embeddings were computed; no similarity results were inspected

gme2b_vs_official_gme_inference_py.reference_environment: transformers 4.51.3, torch 2.6.0+cpu, official GmeQwen2VL class, bfloat16 on CPU
gme2b_vs_official_gme_inference_py.this_environment: transformers 5.23.0, torch 2.15.0+cpu, scripts/embed_models.py as used for all test inputs (slow PIL image processor), bfloat16 on CPU
gme2b_vs_official_gme_inference_py.note: Cosines measured with the final configuration. Remaining differences are bfloat16 kernel differences between library versions and uint8 rounding in image resizing (pixel values differ by 1.2e-4 on average); the reference uses sequential position ids, reproduced explicitly.

qwen3vl2b_vs_sentence_transformers_card_.note: The official qwen3_vl_embedding.py places the image before the text; a text-first dict changes the joint embedding substantially, so the official order is used.

embeddinggemma2_bfloat16_vs_float32_befo.note: Inner products above 1 show that bfloat16 outputs are unit-norm only to about 1e-3; all embeddings are therefore re-normalized in float32.
